name: PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk
summary: PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk operates as a digital distribution company. The company provides digital products for mobile credit and data top up; PPOB; game voucher; tour and travel; music concert and attraction; lifestyle voucher; e-wallet and e-money top up; and branchless banking. It also offers electric vehicles; semolis, an electric motorbike rental; Super API, an end-to-end digital services with API connections; logistics; and cloud advertising platform, such as infrastructure-as-a-service, managed services, and exchange hub.
